summary: Promising chunky sci-fi direction: the courier reads strongly futuristic, and the headgear gives the everyday kits useful silhouette differences. However, several garments still resemble modern workwear with attached gadgets, the Administrator has visibly disconnected hardware, and the envoy needs a stronger foreign android identity.
problems: The Gardener and Apprentice retain conventional shirt-and-trouser construction beneath diagonal apron/sash pieces. Their equipment carries more of the Future identity than their clothing.

The Courier and Weaver repeat the same stacked diagonal chest-panel composition. Their helmets distinguish them, but the garment designs become similar when handheld details disappear at stream scale.

The Administrator's upper monitor supports slope inward while their screens sit outboard, leaving visibly disconnected components. The broad silhouette communicates importance, but the assembly reads as scattered workstation equipment rather than a coherent symbol of office.

Small knee discs, shoulder badges, visor marks and constellation details are too fine to carry essential identity from the elevated stream camera. Much of the palette also clusters around muted midtones.

The envoy's gold frame is a useful foreign silhouette, but the square helmet, local ceramic colours and patched tabard still suggest another town courier rather than the head of an off-world android delegation.
The Administrator's long front strips and the envoy's lower tabard are rigidly hip-mounted over the thigh region. They require walking-pose checks; the standing render does not establish clearance.
fix:
Seed-Capsule Gardener: Keep the broad disc and paired green capsules. Replace the flat tan apron with a stepped seed-storage breastplate containing two large integrated capsule sockets; use an ivory/sage structural yoke over a dark undersuit. Make the disc-to-backpack support visibly continuous and keep its silhouette separate from the head.
Ceramic Wrap-Tabard Courier: Preserve the angular enclosed helmet and segmented ceramic arms—the strongest Future construction here. Join the violet chest pieces into one coherent overlapping shell with a deliberate seam rather than two isolated slabs. Keep the parcel visibly gripped and its contrasting lid readable from above.
Habitat Memory Weaver: Replace the Courier-like stacked chest slabs with a broad asymmetric memory-cowl and shorter torso wrap. Integrate one large cyan memory cartridge into the purple head surround. Retain independently leg-mounted lower panels and the slate, but do not rely on the slate alone for recognition.
Canopy Apprentice: Replace the diagonal sash with a substantial torso-connected climbing harness. Enlarge the segmented thigh/shin housings and preserve clear dark joint gaps. Broaden the visor and make the upright back cartridge visibly dock into the pack, producing a distinct compact technical silhouette.
Administrator of the Shared Constellation: Rebuild the rig as a continuous backpack-to-spar-to-screen assembly; reverse the upper spars' inward lean and place each screen directly on its support endpoint. Mount the constellation on a solid breastplate and repeat it as one large top-facing crest. Shorten the front strips above the moving thighs or articulate their lower sections independently. Check the retained hair against the visor and rig.
Far-Orbit Patched-Tabard Envoy: Keep the gold trapezoidal frame, but anchor it visibly to a rigid backpack. Establish a fixed deep-teal/ochre delegation scheme, a more distinctive segmented android head, a broad amber optic and an exposed mechanical neck. Enlarge the orbit emblem onto a top-facing shoulder plate. Split or articulate the lower tabard for walking.
Across all kits: Mount rigid machinery to stable torso bones, not freely moving cloth. Validate idle, walking and turning at the actual 40-degree stream camera and final character pixel size.
